Procedure: Attended, full-night diagnostic polysomnography.
Clinical Indication: Excessive daytime sleepiness, reported snoring, and witnessed apneas.

Impression: The findings are consistent with severe obstructive sleep apnea (OSA).
A follow-up appointment is recommended to discuss treatment options, including positive airway pressure (PAP) therapy. A subsequent PAP titration study under polysomnography is indicated to determine the optimal pressure for treatment.

C1q: 2+ granular staining in mesangium and capillary loops
Fibrinogen: Negative
Albumin: Negative

Electron Microscopy Description: Electron microscopy confirms diffuse subendothelial and mesangial electron-dense deposits. Tubuloreticular inclusions are present within endothelial cells. There is approximately 50% podocyte foot process effacement.

Comment: The combined findings are diagnostic of active, diffuse global lupus nephritis. ISN/RPS 2003 Class IV-G (A)

correlation and appropriate oncologic management are recommended.
